reality_access_paths.scope: Temporary exact column/index copy; persistence constraints and acceptance are proved by PostgreSQL integration

source_indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX authority_reality_batch_local_idx ON public.authority_reality_event_index USING btree (revision_id, batch_local_id) WHERE (batch_local_id IS NOT NULL)
source_indexes.name: authority_reality_batch_local_idx

source_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX authority_reality_entity_clock_idx ON public.authority_reality_event_index USING btree (book_run_id, state_kind, entity_key, timeline_id, end_ordinal DESC, accepted_chapter) WHERE (world_tick AND (timeline_id IS NOT NULL))
source_indexes.name: authority_reality_entity_clock_idx

source_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX authority_reality_event_clock_idx ON public.authority_reality_event_index USING btree (book_run_id, timeline_id, end_ordinal DESC, accepted_chapter) WHERE world_tick
source_indexes.name: authority_reality_event_clock_idx

source_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX authority_reality_event_frontier_idx ON public.authority_reality_event_index USING btree (book_run_id, accepted_chapter, event_ordinal)
source_indexes.name: authority_reality_event_frontier_idx

source_indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX authority_reality_event_index_pkey ON public.authority_reality_event_index USING btree (book_run_id, event_id)
source_indexes.name: authority_reality_event_index_pkey

source_indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX authority_reality_event_index_revision_id_event_ordinal_key ON public.authority_reality_event_index USING btree (revision_id, event_ordinal)
source_indexes.name: authority_reality_event_index_revision_id_event_ordinal_key

source_indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX authority_reality_preparation_step_idx ON public.authority_reality_event_index USING btree (book_run_id, preparation_action_version_id, preparation_transition_id) INCLUDE (event_id, accepted_chapter) WHERE (preparation_transition_id IS NOT NULL)
source_indexes.name: authority_reality_preparation_step_idx
